summary.text: Stephanie Payeur is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 8 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Payeur was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and lives in Henniker.
She earned an M.B.A. from the University of New Hampshire in 2010, and her career experience includes working in healthcare management.
She has been affiliated with the Henniker Food Pantry and the Henniker Rotary Club.
Ballotpedia lists Payeur's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2022.
